encrypted.no_keys_body: You don't have an encryption key pair set up for your account yet. Generate or restore your encryption keys from your profile menu, then reopen this document.
encrypted.conversion_odf_body: Encrypted documents are opened with a lightweight browser-based editor that does not support all features available in non-encrypted mode. SmartArt elements and some shapes (e.g. Frame, Snip diagonal corner rectangle, math operators, most figured arrows, trapezoid, parallelogram, plus) are known to prevent ODF files (.odt, .ods, .odp) from loading in this mode.
encrypted.conversion_odf_actions: You can download the file to remove the SmartArt or unsupported shapes, then re-upload it. Alternatively, you can remove encryption from this document so it opens with the full-featured editor. If the issue persists after the cleanup, please contact the technical team to investigate.
encrypted.conversion_odf_no_edit: Please contact the owner of this document or a user with editing rights so they can remove the SmartArt, unsupported shapes, or encryption from the file. If the issue persists after the cleanup, please contact the technical team to investigate.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected: This error is unexpected for this file format. You can download the file to inspect it, or try removing encryption — the full-featured editor may be able to open it. If removing encryption works, please contact the technical team so they can investigate why the encrypted editor failed.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected_no_edit: Please contact the owner of this document or a user with editing rights to investigate.
encrypted.save_error_fatal_body: The document contains content we cannot serialize to the on-disk format (often a chart). Your recent edits are visible but unsaved. Please undo the last change or contact support. Details:
encrypted.save_error_transient_title: Sync error — save will be retried
encrypted.save_error_transient_body: We could not upload the latest save. Details:
encrypted.oo_crashed_body: An error occurred while synchronizing with other peers. Because the document is end-to-end encrypted, we cannot always reconcile changes perfectly. Please reload the editor to fetch the latest saved state.

pending_self.title: Waiting for access
pending_self.body_with_keys: This file was encrypted before you enabled encryption, so its key could not be shared with you then. You will get access the next time the file owner opens it.
pending_self.body_without_keys: This file was encrypted before you enabled encryption, so its key could not be shared with you. Enable encryption on your account: you will get access the next time the file owner opens it.

key_unavailable.title: This file was shared with a previous key
key_unavailable.body: That key is no longer on your account, most likely because you reset your encryption. Ask the file owner to remove you from its members and add you again.

key_mismatch.title: This file was encrypted with a different key
key_mismatch.body: Your current encryption key cannot open it. Ask the file owner to remove you from its members and add you again.

content_integrity.title: This file cannot be decrypted
content_integrity.body: Your key is correct, but the stored content is damaged or was altered, so it cannot be trusted. Contact the owner of this file or your support.

unknown.title: This file could not be decrypted
unknown.body: Something went wrong while decrypting this file. Try again.

encrypted.relay_unavailable_headline: Could not reach the collaboration server
encrypted.relay_unavailable_body: We couldn't connect to the collaboration server, so we can't tell whether someone else is currently editing this document. Opening it anyway could overwrite their changes. Please check your network and try again in a few moments, or contact support if the problem persists.
encrypted.peer_state_unavailable_headline: Could not synchronise with the active editor
encrypted.peer_state_unavailable_body: Another user is already editing this document. We tried to fetch their live state to join the session safely, but they didn't respond. Opening the document anyway could corrupt it. Please try again in a few moments, or contact support if the problem persists.

encrypted.stale_resyncing: Reconnexion après une déconnexion prolongée — récupération du document…
encrypted.no_keys_body: Vous n'avez pas encore configuré votre paire de clés de chiffrement. Générez-les ou restaurez-les depuis le menu de votre profil, puis rouvrez ce document.
encrypted.conversion_odf_body: Les documents chiffrés sont ouverts avec un éditeur léger basé sur le navigateur qui ne prend pas en charge toutes les fonctionnalités disponibles en mode non chiffré. Les éléments SmartArt sont connus pour empêcher les fichiers ODF (.odt, .ods, .odp) d'être chargés dans ce mode.
encrypted.conversion_odf_actions: Vous pouvez télécharger le fichier pour en supprimer les éléments SmartArt, puis le re-téléverser. Vous pouvez aussi retirer le chiffrement de ce document pour l'ouvrir avec l'éditeur complet. Si le problème persiste après avoir supprimé les SmartArt, contactez l'équipe technique pour enquête.
encrypted.conversion_odf_no_edit: Veuillez contacter le propriétaire du document ou un utilisateur disposant des droits d'édition pour qu'il supprime les éléments SmartArt ou retire le chiffrement du fichier. Si le problème persiste après suppression des SmartArt, contactez l'équipe technique pour enquête.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected: Cette erreur est inattendue pour ce format de fichier. Vous pouvez télécharger le fichier pour l'inspecter, ou essayer de retirer le chiffrement — l'éditeur complet pourra peut-être l'ouvrir. Si cela fonctionne, contactez l'équipe technique pour qu'elle enquête sur la raison de l'échec de l'éditeur chiffré.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected_no_edit: Veuillez contacter le propriétaire du document ou un utilisateur disposant des droits d'édition pour enquêter.
encrypted.save_error_fatal_title: Échec de l'enregistrement — veuillez contacter le support
encrypted.save_error_fatal_body: Le document contient du contenu que nous ne pouvons pas sérialiser dans le format de stockage (souvent un graphique). Vos modifications récentes sont visibles mais non enregistrées. Veuillez annuler la dernière modification ou contacter le support. Détails :
encrypted.save_error_transient_title: Erreur de synchronisation — l'enregistrement sera réessayé
encrypted.save_error_transient_body: Le dernier enregistrement n'a pas pu être téléversé. Détails :
encrypted.oo_crashed_body: Une erreur est survenue lors de la synchronisation avec les autres participants. Comme le document est chiffré de bout en bout, nous ne pouvons pas toujours réconcilier parfaitement les modifications. Veuillez recharger l'éditeur pour récupérer le dernier état enregistré.
encrypted.oo_crashed_waiting: En attente de l'enregistrement par un autre participant…

pending_self.title: En attente d'accès
pending_self.body_with_keys: Ce fichier a été chiffré avant que vous activiez le chiffrement, sa clé n'a donc pas pu vous être partagée à ce moment-là. Vous aurez accès la prochaine fois que le propriétaire du fichier l'ouvrira.

encrypted.stale_resyncing: Reconnecting after long disconnect — refetching document...
encrypted.no_keys_body: You don't have an encryption key pair set up for your account yet. Generate or restore your encryption keys from your profile menu, then reopen this document.
encrypted.conversion_odf_body: Encrypted documents are opened with a lightweight browser-based editor that does not support all features available in non-encrypted mode. SmartArt elements and some shapes (e.g. Frame, Snip diagonal corner rectangle, math operators, most figured arrows, trapezoid, parallelogram, plus) are known to prevent ODF files (.odt, .ods, .odp) from loading in this mode.
encrypted.conversion_odf_actions: You can download the file to remove the SmartArt or unsupported shapes, then re-upload it. Alternatively, you can remove encryption from this document so it opens with the full-featured editor. If the issue persists after the cleanup, please contact the technical team to investigate.
encrypted.conversion_odf_no_edit: Please contact the owner of this document or a user with editing rights so they can remove the SmartArt, unsupported shapes, or encryption from the file. If the issue persists after the cleanup, please contact the technical team to investigate.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected: This error is unexpected for this file format. You can download the file to inspect it, or try removing encryption — the full-featured editor may be able to open it. If removing encryption works, please contact the technical team so they can investigate why the encrypted editor failed.
encrypted.conversion_unexpected_no_edit: Please contact the owner of this document or a user with editing rights to investigate.
encrypted.save_error_fatal_body: The document contains content we cannot serialize to the on-disk format (often a chart). Your recent edits are visible but unsaved. Please undo the last change or contact support. Details:
encrypted.save_error_transient_title: Sync error — save will be retried
encrypted.save_error_transient_body: We could not upload the latest save. Details:
encrypted.oo_crashed_body: An error occurred while synchronizing with other peers. Because the document is end-to-end encrypted, we cannot always reconcile changes perfectly. Please reload the editor to fetch the latest saved state.

pending_self.title: Waiting for access
pending_self.body_with_keys: This file was encrypted before you enabled encryption, so its key could not be shared with you then. You will get access the next time the file owner opens it.
pending_self.body_without_keys: This file was encrypted before you enabled encryption, so its key could not be shared with you. Enable encryption on your account: you will get access the next time the file owner opens it.

key_unavailable.title: This file was shared with a previous key
key_unavailable.body: That key is no longer on your account, most likely because you reset your encryption. Ask the file owner to remove you from its members and add you again.

key_mismatch.title: This file was encrypted with a different key
key_mismatch.body: Your current encryption key cannot open it. Ask the file owner to remove you from its members and add you again.

content_integrity.title: This file cannot be decrypted
content_integrity.body: Your key is correct, but the stored content is damaged or was altered, so it cannot be trusted. Contact the owner of this file or your support.

unknown.title: This file could not be decrypted
unknown.body: Something went wrong while decrypting this file. Try again.

encrypted.relay_unavailable_body: We konden geen verbinding maken met de samenwerkingsserver, dus we weten niet of iemand anders dit document op dit moment bewerkt. Het toch openen kan hun wijzigingen overschrijven. Controleer uw netwerk en probeer het over enkele ogenblikken opnieuw, of neem contact op met support als het probleem aanhoudt.
encrypted.peer_state_unavailable_headline: Kan niet synchroniseren met de actieve editor
encrypted.peer_state_unavailable_body: Iemand anders bewerkt dit document al. We probeerden hun actuele staat op te halen om veilig aan de sessie deel te nemen, maar kregen geen antwoord. Het document toch openen kan het beschadigen. Probeer het over enkele ogenblikken opnieuw, of neem contact op met support als het probleem aanhoudt.
encrypted.peer_resyncing: Een medebewerker synchroniseert opnieuw, even geduld...
encrypted.flushing_on_close: Uw wijzigingen worden opgeslagen voor het sluiten…
